content.text: If you're a digital creator in countries like Nigeria or Pakistan, you've likely faced roadblocks with platforms like Stripe or PayPal. These services only operate in 46 out of 195 countries, leaving millions without reliable payment processing for their digital products. This post will guide you on how to sell presets without relying on these restricted platforms, offering a sustainable alternative that ensures full ownership and control over your sales process.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

However, platforms such as Stripe and PayPal exclude many countries, forcing creators to find workarounds that may compromise their business integrity. This situation creates a need for a robust, sovereign commerce infrastructure where creators can operate independently without the risk of account suspension or financial isolation. By exploring alternatives that empower creators, we can enable a seamless sales experience without the constraints of traditional platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure for selling digital products without Stripe utilizes a combination of Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Cloudflare Pages provides free hosting, while Workers allow for custom backend logic. Supabase is employed for order management, ensuring data ownership, and NOWPayments offers automatic crypto payment processing with a minimal fee. This architecture allows creators to deploy their stores quickly and efficiently, ensuring that payment processing and product delivery are streamlined and secure.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms have failed them. Artists, educators, and entrepreneurs in Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, and similar countries can leverage this infrastructure to sell ebooks, presets, and other digital products without worrying about payment rejections or account suspensions. By adopting this sovereign commerce model, creators can regain control over their sales and financial futures, tapping into a global market without barriers.
Full ownership of your data means you control your sales process.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The selling infrastructure consists of several key components that work cohesively. Cloudflare Pages serves as the hosting solution, allowing creators to showcase their products. Supabase is utilized for storing orders and customer data securely. Workers enhance functionality with backend processes, while NOWPayments ensures transactions are processed in over 300 cryptocurrencies. This combination not only facilitates sales but also grants creators full ownership of their data and transactions, a critical advantage in today’s digital economy.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To begin selling your presets without Stripe, first, set up a Cloudflare Pages account and deploy your store. Next, integrate Supabase for order management and Workers for custom logic. Finally, connect to NOWPayments for handling cryptocurrency transactions. Each of these steps can be completed quickly, and the entire infrastructure can be operational within 48 hours using the Edge Commerce Stack for just $197. By taking these actions, you enable a reliable sales process free from third-party restrictions.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is unavailable in your country, you can sell digital products by using sovereign commerce infrastructure like Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments. This combination allows you to host your store, manage orders, and process payments without relying on platforms that exclude your region, thus maintaining full ownership and control over your sales.
Zero reliance on platforms that can restrict your business.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
Frequently Asked Questions
What if I can't use PayPal in my country?

If PayPal is not available, explore using NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. This service supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and has minimal fees, making it a viable alternative for creators in restricted regions.
How can I ensure my customers' data is secure?
Utilizing Supabase in your infrastructure ensures that customer data is stored securely and privately. You maintain control over your data, enhancing security and compliance.
What are the costs involved in this setup?
The setup can be done at a low cost using free tools available from Cloudflare and Supabase, with the Edge Commerce Stack priced at $197 for a comprehensive solution including payment processing.
Can I sell multiple digital products with this infrastructure?
Yes, you can sell multiple digital products. The Edge Commerce Stack allows you to load up to 5 products, and you can scale beyond that as your business grows.
How long does it take to get my store up and running?
With the Edge Commerce Stack, you can have your store deployed within 48 hours, allowing you to start selling your presets quickly.
